column1: # Java Usage003_01 palindrome recipes (MatchOnly + MatchedTokenParser slice/effect) / Rust owned-capture adapter.
# The word is the greedy MatchOnly(OneOrMore(AsciiParser)) prefix: U+0000..U+007F only, no shorter retry.
# grammar: single = pal, reuse = pal '😀' pal (same parser instances), retry = ('a' pal) | pal.
# input escapes: \r \n (empty is an empty column). Spans are code points start-end, joined by ','.
# halves: sliceWithWord / sliceWithSlicer steps (first half, pivot or empty, reversed first half).
# whole: effectReverse / sliceReverse / sliceReverseWithPythonian (one reversed word step).
